author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: 5.1.1 fixes a bug that prevented adding or changing a person's geolocation presence sensor when editing an existing person. The device selector did not commit the selection before the Save handler ran, so the person was saved with no device while the selector still displayed the chosen one - making it appear to have saved when it had not. Creating a new person was unaffected. 5.1.0 substantially reduced the app's CPU footprint on the hub. The periodic evidence watchdog now runs every 5 minutes instead of every minute - the failures it guards against (a stalled IP ping schedule, a stuck Guest Mode timer) play out over hours, so minute-level checking bought nothing while multiplying the app's workload fivefold. Internal state initialisation is also now guarded so it runs once rather than re-checking every field on every evaluation cycle. Together these cut the app's routine storage operations by roughly 90 percent, with no change to presence detection behaviour. Also lowers the default IP check interval to 5 minutes and the default consecutive-failure threshold to 1 to match. 5.0.0 was the first public release: it combines Hubitat mobile geolocation presence, phone IP checks and Third Party Services switches into one reliable household occupancy status, designed to avoid false-Away results when a single signal briefly drops out, with a Presence Report (90 day per-person history with CSV export), an optional reverse-geocoded Location Lookup, Guest Mode, and a Diagnostic Mode page showing the exact evidence behind every decision.
